name: List All Jobs
description: List endpoint to display all of the jobs related to bulk operations

queryFilters.name: filters[Id]
queryFilters.description: Filters for jobs. Accepts one or more job UUIDs (comma-separated) to retrieve specific bulk operation jobs.

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the asynchronous bulk create job for the selected resource. This identifier tracks the bulk creation of general ledger accounts, and other supported resources.

responseFields.name: data[].Status
responseFields.description: Indicates the current status of the asynchronous job.

responseFields.name: data[].Result
responseFields.description: The result of the bulk operation job. The result contains either an empty array during processing or the final results after completion, returning an array of objects with a ReferenceId, a Successful status, and a created resource Id. An Errors array will return with a message if the Successful status returns false.

attributes.name: ReferenceId
attributes.description: Unique identifier provided in the original bulk create request to track individual items

attributes.name: ResourceId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the item created. Example: GlAccountId

attributes.name: successful
attributes.description: Indicates whether the individual item in the bulk operation was created successfully

attributes.name: errors
attributes.description: An array of error messages that describes why the creation failed, only present when Successful is false

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
